result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane urban street with marked crosswalks and signalized intersections. While sidewalks and pedestrian signals are present, the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes increase exposure risk for pedestrians.

hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade standard transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility.
